command: ./gradlew --no-daemon -x verifyFrontendToolchain test --tests 'decompengine.web.UploadServerTest.retained-byte upload refusal preserves concurrent listing and status traffic'
test: retained-byte upload refusal preserves concurrent listing and status traffic
scope: Local in-process HTTP qualification. Eight retained jobs and a report file exceed the configured test quota; a client sends multipart headers with a one-million-byte Content-Length but no body. While the dashboard is held at its first physical job.json read and the upload thread is synchronously held inside retained-storage measurement, four status reads complete under two seconds. The request then receives 503/UPLOAD_STORAGE without sending its body; retained bytes and entries remain unchanged. Removing the fixture restores admission and a subsequent upload succeeds.
limitations: The retained ceiling is configured through an internal test seam; this does not qualify the packaged server's default ceiling or production deployment configuration.
The listing delay and filesystem are in-process test fixtures; this does not measure physical-disk contention or deployment throughput.
Does not qualify workflow report-growth enforcement, concurrent upload-slot saturation, hosted CI, or the complete #162 acceptance matrix.
